text:
Ada: Morning! The ficus by reception got a new name suggestion board. Drop your picks. :seedling:
Noah: I nominate 'Sir Photos-a-Lot'. Short, majestic, slightly overexposed. :camera_with_flash:
Sana: Haha love it. I vote 'Leaf Erickson' (pun intended). :compass:
Eli: 'Chlorophyll Collins' for the win. Also whoever left a sticky note fortune in the microwave, reveal yourself. Mine said 'You will find a snack' and I did. :crystal_ball:
ReceptionBot: New board created: /board ficus-names. React to vote.
Ada: Also tiny poll: Friday playlist theme? React :one: Chill lo-fi, :two: Throwback 2000s, :three: Office indie bops.
Noah: :one: sleepy coding is best with lo-fi.
Sana: :three: indie bops please.
Eli: :two: I will judge the playlist harshly if not included.
OpsBot: Poll registered: 1779993333/polls/1. Poll closes 4pm.
Sana: Quick one-liner: 'My plant reminded me to hydrate, so I sent it an expensive water bottle.' :droplet:
Ada: Also found three microwaved mystery lunches with fortunes inside. Sample: 'A surprise meeting will become a snack.' We should bottle these. :laughing:
Noah: Whoever seeded the fortunes is a hero. Suggestion: next batch, make one say 'You will win the desk-decor raffle.'
Eli: Shoutout to Facilities for refilling the hand soap. Tiny wins. :soap:
ReceptionBot: FYI: Visitor today at 3pm. Please keep the ficus dignified.
Sana: Final votes in the board. Tally: Sir Photos-a-Lot 4, Leaf Erickson 2, Chlorophyll Collins 3. Ada: Sir Photos-a-Lot it is! We'll make a tiny nameplate.
Ada: Whoever wrote the microwave fortunes, please DM me your fortune templates. We'll print a batch for the snack table.
Noah: I'll do a lo-fi/indie mash and drop link in #music by 5. May your playlists be bug-free.
Eli: Closing with a one-liner: 'If my plant grows faster than my PR reviews, I'm sending it a performance improvement plan.' :potted_plant:
